title: Efficient and robust approximate nearest neighbor search using Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs
authors: Yu. A. Malkov; D. A. Yashunin

theory: Conditional Delaunay/log-scaling discussion; no universal recall guarantee

difference: No effective resistance or leverage score

title: Approximate nearest neighbor algorithm based on navigable small world graphs

method: Orders insertions by LID or category and measures recall sensitivity
similarity: Direct motivation and mandatory order/LID control
difference: Diagnostic ordering study; no resistance intervention

method: Distance-based adaptive termination for HNSW/Vamana-style beam search
theory: Conditional approximation guarantee when the graph is navigable

title: Worst-case Performance of Popular Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search Implementations: Guarantees and Limitations
method: Adversarial instances for HNSW NSG and DiskANN plus conditional DiskANN analysis
theory: Linear-query lower examples for common variants; bounded-dimension result for slow DiskANN

title: Graph Sparsification by Effective Resistances
method: Samples weighted graph edges proportional to effective resistance
theory: Laplacian quadratic-form preservation with O(n log n / epsilon^2) edges
difference: Preserves spectra not greedy ANN navigation; samples existing edges rather than adding candidates

title: Towards Optimal Effective Resistance Estimation
method: Fast approximation of all edge resistances

title: A New Notion of Effective Resistance for Directed Graphs Part I: Definition and Properties
authors: George Forrest Young; Luca Scardovi; Naomi Ehrich Leonard
